on run argv
  set t to item 1 of argv
  set m to item 2 of argv
  set secs to (item 3 of argv) as integer
  try
    set r to display dialog m with title t buttons {"Cancel", "Approve"} default button "Cancel" cancel button "Cancel" with icon caution giving up after secs
    if gave up of r then return "timeout"
    return "approved"
  on error
    return "declined"
  end try
end run
